goal: Upgrade the Human Psychological Core into an evidence-grounded, mechanistic, interconnected, context-sensitive, self-checking, auditable social-media human psychology reasoning system that satisfies all 10/10 quality dimensions without relying on arbitrary node counts.
deliverable: A validated multi-level psychological reasoning architecture spanning 8 core families, mechanism modules, neurons/micro-neurons, typed edges, empirical evidence, measurement mappings, executable reasoning, adversarial benchmarks, and CI-backed verification.
protected_constraints: Keep the eight current core families as candidate anchors until evidence-based architecture review decides otherwise.
Do not model the system as a linear funnel.
Do not convert correlation into causation.
Do not convert pooled effect sizes directly into graph weights without a justified calibration model.
Do not equate platform metrics with latent psychological states.
Search for contradictory evidence and boundary conditions, not only confirming evidence.
Do not declare 10/10 from volume of files, papers, neurons, edges, or tokens.
Do not weaken mandatory quality gates to finish faster.
Reuse accepted repository state; invalidate only affected descendants when upstream assumptions change.

route.architecture: planner -> bounded core research workstreams -> cross-core integrator -> reasoning/measurement implementer -> independent verifier
workstreams: S2 cross-core connector and edge program
tools: GitHub repository state and version control
academic/public web retrieval from primary sources and high-quality syntheses
deterministic Python/tests for validation and benchmarking
route.unavailable_optional_dependency: Scite MCP currently requires a paid plan/trial, so completion must not depend on it.

scale_envelope.principle: Counts are capacity ranges, not completion criteria. Expand only when decomposition materially improves explanation, evidence mapping, reasoning, measurement, or verification.
scale_envelope.provisional_module_capacity: roughly 4-12 mechanism modules per core if justified
scale_envelope.provisional_neuron_capacity: roughly 15-50 substantive neurons per core if justified
scale_envelope.micro_neurons: on demand only where a neuron still bundles separable mechanisms or measurements
scale_envelope.material_edges: no fixed target; every edge must earn inclusion through mechanism + evidence + integration value
scale_envelope.replan_trigger: If a core cannot achieve coverage without exceeding the envelope, or if major overlap suggests a different ontology, return to Scale rather than forcing the counts.

saturation_rule.unit_level: A unit may stop expanding when its major mechanisms, alternatives, moderators, contradictions, measurement paths, and material connections are represented and further targeted retrieval adds only marginal refinement.
saturation_rule.core_level: A core may close only after at least one deliberate disconfirmation pass and a cross-core overlap/gap review.
saturation_rule.system_level: Final saturation requires no open critical gap, no unsupported strong edge, no unresolved major ontology conflict, passing reasoning/adversarial tests, and CI success.

escalation_triggers: A candidate core splits into two independently necessary mechanisms.
Two cores materially overlap and cannot be separated cleanly.
A major mechanism does not fit any current core.
Repeated evidence conflicts cannot be represented by existing edge/context schema.
Measurement cannot distinguish competing latent explanations.
Reasoning benchmarks fail despite adequate evidence and implementation.
Current decomposition becomes too coarse or too fragmented for retrieval/verification.
next_action: Preserve this release as the Human Psychological Core v1 baseline. Future work may harden bounded evidence gaps or begin a separately scoped next stage; do not alter canonical claims or runtime semantics without reopening the affected evidence/validation gates.

research_progress.internal_quality_target: 10/10 achieved within declared Human Psychological Core scope
research_progress.note: Bounded/provisional/deferred knowledge remains explicit and cannot support strong conclusions until its own evidence gates pass.
